verses.text: "At that time," says the LORD, "the bones of the kings of Judah and its officials, the bones of the priests and prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be taken out of their graves.

They will be spread out under the sun, the moon, and all the stars of the sky, which they loved and served, followed and asked for help, and worshiped. Their bones will not be gathered up or buried. They will be like manure lying on the ground.
All the survivors of this evil nation, in all the places where I have driven them, will choose death rather than life," says the LORD of Armies.
"Say to them, 'This is what the LORD says: When people fall down, do they not get up again? When someone turns away, do they not come back?
Then why have these people of Jerusalem turned away and kept on turning away? They hold on to lies. They refuse to come back.

I have listened carefully, but they do not say what is right. No one is sorry for their wickedness and says, "What have I done?" Each one keeps running their own way, like a horse charging into battle.
Even the stork in the sky knows her seasons. The dove, the swift, and the thrush know when it is time to move. But my people do not know what the LORD requires.
How can you say, "We are wise, for we have the law of the LORD," when the lying pens of the teachers of the law have turned it into a lie?
The wise will be put to shame. They will be shocked and trapped. Since they have rejected the word of the LORD, what kind of wisdom do they really have?
So I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for money. Prophets and priests alike, they all lie and cheat.
They treat the wounds of my people as if they were not serious. They say, "Peace, peace," when there is no peace.

Are they ashamed of their disgusting actions? No, they have no shame at all. They do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among those who fall. When I punish them, they will be brought down, says the LORD.
I will take away their harvest, says the LORD. There will be no grapes on the vine and no figs on the tree. Even the leaves will dry up. What I gave them will be taken from them.'"

"Why are we sitting here? Let us gather together! Let us run to the walled cities and die there! For the LORD our God has sentenced us to die. He has given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
We hoped for peace, but nothing good came. We hoped for a time of healing, but there was only terror.

The snorting of the enemy's horses is heard all the way from Dan. The whole land trembles at the neighing of their stallions. They have come to destroy the land and everything in it, the city and all who live there."
"Look, I am sending poisonous snakes among you, snakes that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you," says the LORD.
My sorrow is beyond healing. My heart is sick inside me.
Listen to the cry of my people from a land far away: "Is the LORD not in Zion? Is her King no longer there?" "Why have they made me angry with their idols, their worthless foreign gods?"
"The harvest is over, the summer has ended, and we are not saved."
Because my people are crushed, I am crushed. I mourn, and horror grips me.
Is there no healing ointment in Gilead? Is there no doctor there? Then why has my people's wound not been healed?
